difficulty_reason: The counted object includes the general repeated-degree decomposition algorithm and its complexity theorem. The substantive step is reduction from invertible change-of-basis matrices to Grassmannian subspaces, exploiting complementary-space equivalence and Schubert cells before recursive splitting. The final bound records this construction as a parameter-dependent algorithm for all finite-field presentations; it is distinct from the interval-only cubic algorithm.
